name: WiredNYC – All Buildings Data
description:
This dataset contains connectivity and telecommunications infrastructure profiles for 323 New York City buildings, drawn from the WiredNYC building assessment program. Each row represents one building, identified by a building_id, and records its borough along with a certification_class indicating how well the building is wired (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Connected, or Not certified). The remaining fields describe physical and operational connectivity features: the number of carriers and internet service providers serving the building, whether coax cable, fiber, and satellite or fixed wireless connections are present, the extent of fiber distribution across floors, and details about points of entry, designated telecom utility space, riser space for current and additional providers, diverse riser locations, signed points of entry, and provider agreements. Two free-text fields list specific ISP names. Most fields are categorical, and missing values are modest except for the ISP name fields, where roughly a third of rows lack data.

The data supports analyses of broadband infrastructure quality and equity across the five boroughs,
